correctness.rationale: For a two-state detailed-balance Markov model and constant load, integrating occupation gives W_T(w)=w(p−q(w))(1−e^(−lambda(w)T)). Factor W as w*sinh[c(Phi−w)]*K_T(lambda). Strict log curvature follows the exact variance inequality v_{lambda,T}<mu_{lambda,T}/lambda and lambda'²=c²(lambda²−4k²), lambda''=c²lambda. The log derivative at w=E is sign(p−(1/2+βE/4)), independent of T, and implicit differentiation yields positive/negative horizon drift on the respective branches. Short/long horizon extrema and exponential charging/retention follow. Independently solved maximizers for several p,T parameter sets, verifying direction and threshold; these finite optimizations do not prove global concavity.
